channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Pier 70 Parcel K South (PKS) (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel K South (PKS): Pier 70 Parcel K South now uses real Assessor lot lines.
item.description: Pier 70 Parcel K South now uses real Assessor lot lines. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lot 4110013.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel K South (PKS): The 2033 date on this record was drawn as an expected completion. The Port's 2017 staff report calls it an outside date in the Development Agreement's Schedule of Performance (Phase 2 within 16 years of approval), not a construction schedule. It is now labelled a legal deadline and no longer moves this record's status on the map or the timeline.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel K South (PKS): The 2033 completion milestone is now labelled a soft 2017 outside date that down market delay has tolled and Port Item 11A proposes to reset, not a current expectation. Resolution 17-52 is described as the Parcel K North sale approval that subdivides the whole 20th/Illinois parcel, and the DDA is said to cover Parcel K South's horizontal improvements but not its vertical option. The Oct 24, 2017 Board hearing is described as scheduled rather than held, the Item 11A milestone is dated to the Aug 7, 2026 staff report, and the Irish Hill Corner Plaza is placed at the HDY3/HDY1/2 corner. The map notes say Parcel K South is a Port parcel outside Brookfield's site and drop an uncited brochure. The D4D citation no longer calls it an 'adopted' document.

item.title: Expected · Pier 70 Parcel K South (PKS): Completion of Phase 2 was due under the 2017 DDA within 16 years of Project approval (about 2033); not a current forecast for this stand-alone affordable parcel, which the Port's proposed 2026 phasing plan groups in subphase 2B and whose gap funding is not yet available (~2033)

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel K South (PKS): Board of Supervisors resolution of intention calls a public hearing for October 24, 2017 on forming Infrastructure and Revitalization Financing District No. 2 (Hoedown Yard) to finance affordable housing within Pier 70 and Parcel K South; the Port's Sept 2017 packet only schedules the hearing, and whether it was held that day was not confirmed (Oct 24, 2017)

Source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel K South (PKS): Port Commission approves subdividing the 20th/Illinois parcel into the Plaza Parcel, Parcel K North, the 21st Street right-of-way extension and Parcel K South, with PKS 'developed as an affordable housing site' (Resolution 17-52 recitals) (Sep 26, 2017)
item.description: Port Commission approves subdividing the 20th/Illinois parcel into the Plaza Parcel, Parcel K North, the 21st Street right-of-way extension and Parcel K South, with PKS 'developed as an affordable housing site' (Resolution 17-52 recitals) (Sep 26, 2017). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22.

item.title: Planned · Pier 70 Parcel K South (PKS): Port Commission Resolution 17-52 (the Parcel K North sale approval) has the Port subdivide the 20th/Illinois parcel into four parcels (the Plaza Parcel, Parcel K North, the 21st Street right-of-way extension parcel and Parcel K South), with Parcel K South to be 'developed as an affordable housing site'; the 28-Acre DDA excludes Parcel K South from the developer's vertical option, but Port Item 11A says the DDA makes the developer responsible for its horizontal improvements (Sep 26, 2017)
